data.name: RelationshipType_Display_Key
data.comment: Display name for relationship type selection

data.name: RelationshipType_Desc_Key
data.value: Choose 'Native' for N:N relationships, 'Intersect' for custom intersect tables, or 'Connection' for Dataverse connections. Default is 'Native'.
data.comment: Description for relationship type property

data.name: IntersectTable_Display_Key
data.comment: Display name for intersect table schema name (for Intersect mode)

data.name: IntersectTable_Desc_Key
data.value: The schema name of the custom intersect table (e.g., 'new_tagging'). Required when using Intersect mode.
data.comment: Description for intersect table property

data.name: PrimaryLookup_Display_Key
data.comment: Display name for primary lookup navigation property in intersect table

data.name: PrimaryLookup_Desc_Key
data.value: The single-valued navigation property name for the lookup to the primary entity on the intersect table. This is used with @odata.bind and can differ from the lookup column name. Required when using Intersect mode.
data.comment: Description for primary lookup navigation property

data.name: SecondaryLookup_Display_Key
data.comment: Display name for secondary lookup navigation property in intersect table

data.name: SecondaryLookup_Desc_Key
data.value: The single-valued navigation property name for the lookup to the tag entity on the intersect table. This is used with @odata.bind and can differ from the lookup column name. Required when using Intersect mode.
data.comment: Description for secondary lookup navigation property

data.name: IntersectNameField_Display_Key
data.comment: Display name for intersect table primary name field

data.name: IntersectNameField_Desc_Key
data.value: The schema name of the text field in the intersect table to store the selected tag name (e.g., 'new_name'). Required when using Intersect mode.
data.comment: Description for intersect name field property

data.name: RelationshipTypeField_Display_Key
data.comment: Display name for relationship type choice field logical name

data.name: RelationshipTypeField_Desc_Key
data.value: The logical name of the choice column used to categorize relationship records. Used in Intersect and Connection modes.
data.comment: Description for relationship type field name property

data.name: RelationshipTypeValues_Display_Key
data.comment: Display name for relationship type choice values list

data.name: RelationshipTypeValues_Desc_Key
data.value: Comma-separated integer values for the relationship type choice column (for example: 100000000,100000001). Used in Intersect and Connection modes.
data.comment: Description for relationship type values property
